The '''snow shovel''' is an iron shovel variant that clears snow very quickly but digs everything else very slowly.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
It mines snow blocks at speed 15 and other shovel blocks at speed 0.15, with 5000 durability. It deals 4.5 damage at speed 1 and is repaired with iron ingots.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/snow_shovel.json}}</ref> Its tooltip shows mining speed 1.
